items.summary: hipcub::DeviceRadixSort::SortPairs (rocPRIM 4.6.0 / hipCUB 4.7.0, ROCm 10.1 pip SDK; gfx90a) returns a corrupted permutation for float keys that mix quiet and signaling NaNs: values duplicated and missing, unwritten output slots keep stale data (n=136064 randn + 2000 qNaN + 50 sNaN -> 33368 duplicated / 41509 missing; either NaN kind alone sorts correctly; quieting the sNaNs fixes it). torch.sort on ROCm inherits it; LiteGS hit it by sorting uninitialized depth values and then failed a device-side index assert. Standalone reproducer in projects/LiteGS/notes.md (2026-11-19 section). Not yet filed upstream (ROCm/rocm-libraries, project: rocprim); filing is a person's call.

hipCUB/rocPRIM DeviceRadixSort::SortPairs on float keys that contain BOTH signaling and quiet NaNs returns a broken permutation (values duplicated and missing, output slots never written). Either NaN kind alone sorts correctly; CUDA's cub sorts the same keys correctly. Seen on ROCm 10.1 (rocPRIM 4.6.0, hipCUB 4.7.0) on gfx90a and gfx1201; reached through torch.sort in LiteGS's trainer, where it ends in an out-of-range index and HSA_STATUS_ERROR_EXCEPTION 0x1016. Standalone reproducer (no torch, synthetic keys) is in projects/LiteGS/notes.md, porter round 2026-11-19: 136064 keys + 2000 quiet + 50 signaling NaNs gives 33368 duplicated and 41509 missing indices on gfx90a. No existing upstream issue found (searched rocm-libraries, rocPRIM, hipCUB, rocThrust, pytorch on 2026-11-18).
